name: Storage Sense
description: Zet Storage Sense wekelijks aan. Ruimt tijdelijke bestanden op en verwijdert items die langer dan 30 dagen in de Prullenbak staan. OneDrive-bestanden die 30 dagen niet zijn geopend, worden weer online-only. De map Downloads wordt niet automatisch opgeschoond.

settings.name: Allow Storage Sense
settings.description: Turns on Storage Sense for the device, so it automatically runs to free up disk space according to the configured cadence.
settings.rationale: Enforcing Storage Sense ensures automatic disk cleanup runs consistently across devices instead of depending on each user enabling it manually, keeping local disk usage predictable.

settings.id: Allow Storage Sense Temporary Files Cleanup
settings.name: Allow Storage Sense Temporary Files Cleanup
settings.description: Allows Storage Sense to delete the user's temporary files that are not in use when it runs.
settings.rationale: Regularly clearing unused temporary files reduces unnecessary disk usage and removes transient data that has no further purpose once it is no longer in use.

settings.id: Configure Storage Sense Cloud Content Dehydration Threshold
settings.name: Configure Storage Sense Cloud Content Dehydration Threshold
settings.description: Sets the minimum number of days a cloud-backed file (such as a OneDrive file) can remain unopened before Storage Sense dehydrates it back to online-only.
settings.rationale: Dehydrating OneDrive content that has not been opened in 30 days frees up local disk space for infrequently used files while keeping them available online, without permanently deleting any data.

settings.id: Configure Storage Sense Downloads Cleanup Threshold
settings.name: Configure Storage Sense Downloads Cleanup Threshold
settings.description: Sets the minimum number of days a file in the Downloads folder can remain unopened before Storage Sense deletes it. A value of 0 means files in Downloads are never automatically deleted.
settings.rationale: Leaving this threshold at 0 ensures the Downloads folder is excluded from automatic cleanup, since users may rely on files there that have not been moved or opened recently.

settings.name: Configure Storage Sense Cadence
settings.description: Sets how often Storage Sense runs: during low free disk space, daily, weekly, or monthly.
settings.rationale: Running Storage Sense on a weekly cadence provides regular, predictable cleanup without waiting for the device to run low on disk space, while avoiding the overhead of a daily run.

settings.id: Configure Storage Sense Recycle Bin Cleanup Threshold
settings.name: Configure Storage Sense Recycle Bin Cleanup Threshold
settings.description: Sets the minimum age, in days, that a file can remain in the Recycle Bin before Storage Sense deletes it.
settings.rationale: Automatically purging Recycle Bin items older than 30 days frees up disk space while still giving users a reasonable window to recover accidentally deleted files.

changelog.notes: Release of Storage Sense baseline version 1.0.0, converted from an Intune Settings Catalog export.
